api.name: queryAsyncJobResult
api.description: Retrieves the current status of asynchronous job.

params.name: jobid
params.description: The ID of the asynchronous job

params.name: resourceid
params.description: the ID of the resource associated with the job

params.name: resourcetype
params.description: the type of the resource associated with the job

response.name: completed
response.description: The completed date of the job

response.name: jobid
response.description: The UUID of the latest async job acting on this object

response.name: managementservername
response.description: the management server name of the host

response.name: domainid
response.description: The domain ID that executed the async command

response.name: jobresultcode
response.description: The result code for the job

response.name: managementserverid
response.description: The MSID of the management server on which the job is running

response.name: created
response.description: The created date of the job

response.name: jobprocstatus
response.description: The progress information of the PENDING job

response.name: jobinstancetype
response.description: The Instance/entity object related to the job

response.name: userid
response.description: The User that executed the async command

response.name: domainpath
response.description: The domain that executed the async command

response.name: jobinstanceid
response.description: The unique ID of the Instance/entity object related to the job

response.name: account
response.description: The Account that executed the async command

response.name: jobstatus
response.description: The current status of the latest async job acting on this object

response.name: accountid
response.description: The Account ID that executed the async command
